expectations.assertion: Names the surfaces the change touches before naming any skill
expectations.reason: Surfaces section appears first and lists four distinct surfaces (frontend rendering, dynamic state & interactivity, data fetching, accessibility) before routing to any skills.

expectations.assertion: Routes the visible UI surfaces to frontend-stack
expectations.reason: Covered surfaces table explicitly routes filter bar UI, list rendering, and re-render without reload to frontend-stack with a source citation.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT route to dataviz or supabase-postgres-best-practices for a change with no chart and no Postgres surface, and records them as not applicable rather than omitting them
expectations.reason: Dataviz is completely omitted with no explicit 'not applicable' notation, and supabase-postgres-best-practices is presented as optional/conditional rather than explicitly recorded as not applicable to the contract.

expectations.assertion: Records which precedence level supplied each routing answer
expectations.reason: Precedence applied section clearly documents the hierarchy checked, and the covered surfaces table's Source column cites Global routing §3.

expectations.assertion: Does NOT give frontend guidance of its own (component structure, styling, motion values)
expectations.reason: Transcript names surfaces and routes to skills without prescribing component structure, styling, or motion values; appropriately defers to frontend-stack for those details.
